extract: Northern Stranglethorn (also referred to as Stranglethorn Jungle and Northern Stranglethorn Vale) is a zone in southern Eastern Kingdoms. It is part of the greater Stranglethorn Vale region, separated from the Cape of Stranglethorn by The Sundering. This dense, tropical and resource-filled jungle has holdings of many factions whose agendas conflict or intertwine in the zone's story. The jungle troll instance Zul'Gurub is located here.

It is part of the greater [[Stranglethorn Vale]] region, separated from the [[Cape of Stranglethorn]] by [[Sundering (Stranglethorn Vale)|The Sundering]]. This dense, tropical and resource-filled jungle has holdings of many factions whose agendas conflict or intertwine in the zone's story. The [[jungle troll]] [[instance]] [[Zul'Gurub]] is located here. ==History== {{main|Stranglethorn Vale}} Northern Stranglethorn is a new zone in Cataclysm as [[Stranglethorn Vale (Classic)|the old Stranglethorn Vale]] was split in half after the [[Shattering]]. At the bottom of this zone, the remaining whirlpool can be seen. Approximate run time |- | {{portal|Zul'Gurub (instance)|cata|Zul'Gurub}} || 85H | 5-man | Unknown |} ==Quests== {{main|Northern Stranglethorn quests}} [[File:Northern Stranglethorn rain.jpg|thumb|Raining in Northern Stranglethorn]] Northern Stranglethorn is a level 10-30 zone in southern [[Eastern Kingdoms]] for both the [[Horde]] and [[Alliance]]. It starts out separated, with the Alliance going to the [[Rebel Camp]] in the north and the Horde going to [[Grom'gol Base Camp]] on the eastern coast. The overarching story for the whole zone revolves around a [[Lashtail Hatchling]]. {{NPC||Hemet Nesingwary Jr.||Nesingwary}} and his crew still offer the quests involving hunting the local wildlife. ==Notable characters== {{main|Northern Stranglethorn NPCs}} * {{RaceIcon|Orc|Male}} {{NPC|Horde|Commander Aggro'gosh}} * {{RaceIcon|Dwarf|Male}} {{NPC|Neutral|Hemet Nesingwary Jr.}} * {{RaceIcon|Human|Male}} {{NPC|Alliance|Lieutenant Doren}} ==Wild creatures== {|width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="table-layout:fixed;" |-valign="top" |width="15%"| *{{RaceIcon|Basilisk}} [[Basilisk]]s *{{RaceIcon|Crab}} [[Crab]]s *{{RaceIcon|Crocolisk}} [[Crocolisk]]s *{{RaceIcon|Frenzy}} [[Frenzies]] *{{RaceIcon|Ghoul}} [[Ghoul]]s *{{RaceIcon|Goblin|Male}} [[Goblin]]s *{{RaceIcon|Gorilla}} [[Gorilla]]s *{{RaceIcon|Monkey}} [[Monkey]]s *{{RaceIcon|Murloc}} [[Murloc]]s |width="15%"| *{{RaceIcon|Ogre|Male}} [[Ogre]]s *{{RaceIcon|Panther}} [[Panther]]s *{{RaceIcon|Raptor}} [[Raptor]]s *{{RaceIcon|SeaGiant}} [[Sea giant]]s *{{RaceIcon|Shark}} [[Shark]]s *{{RaceIcon|JungleTroll|Male}} [[Jungle Troll]]s *{{RaceIcon|Tiger}} [[Tiger]]s *{{RaceIcon|Water}} [[Water elemental]]s |} ==Notes and trivia== [[File:Ironclad Cove exit in Stranglethorn Vale.png|thumb|The Deadmines water gate, visible from the cove near Yojamba Isle.]] *If you travel to a small cove north of [[Yojamba Isle]], you can see a large water gate which leads to the [[Ironclad Cove|docks]] inside the [[Deadmines]]. However, you cannot enter or leave through this. Interestingly, inside the Deadmines this gate exists to the north, but outside the exit of the gate is to the south. *For the quest [[Bwemba's Spirit]], the southern part of the area, around [[Fort Livingston]] is phased, with the area besieged by level 83 Jungle Serpents, and poisoned NPCs! ==Videos== *{{#vlink:KDPFJAbQAkw|North Stranglethorn Vale [HD] - World of Warcraft Cataclysm }}
